rows.operation: Using CQC data exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: CQC provider, location and rating data describe regulated care services and published assessments; they do not establish current safety for an individual patient, household or exact parcel.

rows.operation: CQC ratings and percentage scores exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: CQC ratings and percentage bands are regulatory judgements for assessed services; they must not be converted into a medical outcome prediction or neighbouring parcel score.

rows.operation: CQC services-in-area map, data sheets and API exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Mapped service locations and latest published ratings support service discovery only; map proximity is not evidence of care availability, capacity, treatment quality or parcel safety.

rows.operation: CQC levels of ratings exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Service, location and trust-level rating aggregation must remain at the published assessment level; values cannot be propagated to an address, resident or nearby parcel.

rows.operation: Incidents and Resilience Annual Report 2025/26 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: National incident, outbreak and signal-management findings support food-safety system context; they do not prove contamination or risk at a specific business, home or parcel.

rows.operation: DVSA annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Agency activity, service and performance reporting is institutional road-safety context and cannot establish the condition of a specific vehicle, road segment or parcel.

rows.operation: Product Safety Database annual report 2025 to 2026 release announcement exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: A release announcement contains no final statistical results and must not be treated as evidence of product prevalence, geographic exposure or parcel risk.

rows.operation: RAIB investigation reports, safety digests and urgent safety advice 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Investigation reports and urgent advice concern defined occurrences and safety learning; they cannot be generalized into a deterministic risk score for every nearby property or trackside parcel.
